title: Quick adjust quantity (+/- row swap)
description: Per-row +/- quantity buttons that swap just that row via htmx, without opening the edit form
spec:
1. Confirm each inventory row has + and - quantity buttons.
2. Click + on a row; confirm the quantity increments by 1 and only that row's fragment is swapped (no full page reload, no edit form).
3. Click - on a row; confirm the quantity decrements by 1 with a single-row swap.
4. Confirm quantity cannot go below 0 (the - button is disabled or the server clamps at 0).
5. Confirm the change persists via the data-access layer (reload the page and verify).
6. Confirm a quick-adjust that crosses the low-stock threshold updates the low-stock nav count accordingly.
7. Confirm the buttons have accessible labels and are keyboard-operable.
